name: research-crew
description: A crew for surveys and adoption decisions: a coordinator frames the question, researchers gather and synthesise sources and map the codebase, a tool evaluator vets candidates, and an independent checker gates the conclusions.
when_to_use: Use when we need the landscape mapped, a tool vetted, or an existing codebase understood before deciding.

routines.description: Map the options for a question in a comparison table with the parameters named, and keep any recommendation separate from the survey.
routines.name: Landscape survey

routines.description: Inspect a candidate tool or skill first-hand for license, safety, and fit before recommending that we adopt it.
routines.name: Vet before adopt
